const key = "x";
class A { [key]: number; }
class B { ["y"]: number; }
class C { [key]: number; constructor() { this[key] = 1; } }
class D { [key]: number; constructor() { this.x = 1; } }
class E { ["y"]: number; constructor() { this["y"] = 1; } }
class F { [key]: number = 1; }
class G { [key]?: number; }
class H { [key]!: number; }
class J { [0]: number; }
const n = 1;
class K { [n]: number; constructor() { this[1] = 2; } }
const sym = Symbol();
class L { [sym]: number; }
class M { x: number; constructor() { this[key] = 1; } }
let lk = "z";
class N { [lk]: number; }
console.log(new A().x, B, C, D, E, F, G, H, J, K, L, M, N);
